results.title: Fees & Passes - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)
highlights:
#### Vehicle Reservations Not Required to Enter Yellowstone

Although an entrance pass is required to enter Yellowstone National Park, vehicle reservations are not needed. You are encouraged to purchase an entrance pass before arriving to save time, but you may also purchase passes at any entrance station upon arrival. Find out more about entrance passes below.

#### Heads Up: Two Parks, Two Fees

Traveling through Yellowstone's South Entrance—including trips to Jackson, WY—takes you through Grand Teton National Park. Each park charges its own entrance fee!

results.title: Entrance Fees by Park (U.S. National Park Service)
highlights:
## What "Private Vehicle" means

At some parks, the price of a standard entrance pass (the entrance fee) depends on whether you enter in a vehicle. The "Private Vehicle" price is the entrance fee for one vehicle and its passengers. At these parks, the " Per Person" price is the entrance fee if you instead enter on a bicycle or on foot. Vehicle and motorcycle passengers don't need a separate pass.
